scope: New native integration; previous-tool success is not evidence for this tool.

left.scope: New left robot only; source files unchanged. Right gun-hand material remains separately configured.

right.scope: Sliding coefficients matched. MuJoCo and PhysX friction solvers are not asserted equivalent.

gun.scope: Unmeasured low-mass mechanical draft; passive trigger, no attachment or hose forces.

profile.scope: Sparse coarse visible cleanroom-contaminant surrogates, not calibrated composition or nanofabrication cleanliness. Nominal densities and 6-weight breakable point bonds are engineering assumptions. Quadratic drag uses measured-orientation projected mesh area; no chemistry, airflow torque, moisture or film model.

cpu_stability.scope: Translation force-equation bound up to 40 m/s relative air speed; not contact-solver or native-run validation.

geometry_evidence.scope: Authored convex collision mesh in rigid-body coordinates, including root scale; live body poses are measured separately.

gun_contact_interval.source: Existing scene.update contact sensors: gun body/stand; tip0/trigger and tip1/gun body.
gun_contact_interval.scope: Engineering contact means and stand-force peak; no additional physics steps or task-score thresholds.

native_adapter.physics_scope: New actual-YAM/PhysX test; local fixture success is not native validation.
native_adapter.force_scope: Partner-filtered rigid-body normal-vector norms, not per-shape forces. Collider geometry must independently exclude non-land wafer contact.
native_adapter.spring_scope: Two fixed passive spring-rest targets; no commanded jaw trajectory or attachment.
native_adapter.handle_contact_frame_scope: Design contact points on the actual fixed/slider handle faces, transformed by measured body poses; not measured per-contact locations.

left_robot_material.scope: New left robot only; source files unchanged. Right gun-hand material remains separately configured.

grasp_calibration.source: Actual PhysX cooked fingertip convex vertices and measured link poses
grasp_calibration.approach_orientation: Native side entry: hand X closes along tool Z; hand Z points along tool Y.
grasp_calibration.scope: Geometric starting map only; native contact/retention must be tested.

verified_native_trigger_spring.scope: Native SI buffer readback, not a physical spring-response or grasp result.

gun_contact_scope: Filtered rigid-body vectors and residuals; no per-shape force or cancellation-proof collision guarantee.

particle_force_audit.scope: Online composer readback before each existing physics update callback; source-bound force calculation, not an independent solver-force measurement or task score.

particle_force_timing: After each existing 0.5 ms physics update, applied for next interval.

source.triangulation: ConvexHull of unmodified cooked vertices; no jitter, dilation or dynamics changes

robot_geometry.scope: All measured link poses; same-link, direct-joint neighbors and finger-carriage sibling overlap excluded. No continuous-time claim.

left.scope: Verified spawn root plus complete cooked collider, joint and measured body inventories.

right.scope: Verified spawn root plus complete cooked collider, joint and measured body inventories.

integrity_scope: Actual composed USD geometry/topology plus live PhysX fixture and robot poses; not material-damage prediction.
collision_scope: Sampled robot self/inter-arm geometry at 20 Hz; not continuous or all-physics-step collision validation.

inspect_trial.observations: Three RGB cameras and measured14-D joints only.
